title: Chip giants participated in startup funding rounds collectively surpassing $250B YTD; Nvidia leads the sector in deal volume with a record 59 funding rounds (Joanna Glasner/Crunchbase News)
summary: Joanna Glasner / Crunchbase News: Chip giants participated in startup funding rounds collectively surpassing $250B YTD; Nvidia leads the sector in deal volume with a record 59 funding rounds — Anyone with a stock portfolio has invariably noticed that semiconductor companies are on a tear this year.
